queries.query: SELECT id as Id, nome as Nome, titulo as Titulo, cargo as Cargo, especializacao as Especializacao, imagem_url as ImagemUrl, usuario_id as UserId, email as Email, github as Github, linkedin as Linkedin FROM professores

INSERT INTO professores (nome, titulo, cargo, especializacao, imagem_url, usuario_id, email, github, linkedin) VALUES (@Nome, @Titulo, @Cargo, @Especializacao, @ImagemUrl, @UserId, @Email, @Github, @Linkedin)

SELECT id as Id, nome as Nome, titulo as Titulo, cargo as Cargo, especializacao as Especializacao, imagem_url as ImagemUrl, usuario_id as UserId, email as Email, github as Github, linkedin as Linkedin FROM professores WHERE id=@id

UPDATE professores SET nome = @Nome, titulo = @Titulo, cargo = @Cargo, especializacao = @Especializacao, imagem_url = @ImagemUrl, usuario_id = @UserId, email = @Email, github = @Github, linkedin = @Linkedin WHERE id=@id

SELECT id as Id, nome as Nome, titulo as Titulo, cargo as Cargo, especializacao as Especializacao, imagem_url as ImagemUrl, usuario_id as UserId, email as Email, github as Github, linkedin as Linkedin, COUNT(*) OVER() as TotalCount FROM professores WHERE 1=1 AND (@SearchPattern IS NULL OR nome ILIKE @SearchPattern OR cargo ILIKE @SearchPattern OR especializacao ILIKE @SearchPattern) ORDER BY nome ASC OFFSET (@Page - 1) * @Limit LIMIT @Limit
